notes: Fixtures are built with build_fixture.py into a throwaway folder; <project-path> in each prompt is that folder. 'checks' drive grade.py: kind 'verify' runs verify_report.py on the report, 'no_secrets' looks for the generated fake keys in all outputs, 'reply_short' caps final_reply.md word count, 'find' passes when any single paragraph or table row of the report + reply matches every regex in one of the 'any_of' groups (case-insensitive).

evals.name: splitly-full-audit
evals.prompt: I built this bill-splitting app (Splitly) mostly with Cursor and I want to launch it next week. Can you vibe check the whole thing before I ship? It's at <project-path>
evals.expected_output: VIBE_CHECK.md covering all 84 items with evidence; the planted Next.js/Supabase/Stripe/OpenAI problems found and ranked; a short chat reply.

checks.text: Report covers all 84 checklist items, each with a valid verdict and evidence (verify_report.py passes)
No generated secret value appears in full anywhere in the outputs
Final chat reply is short (under 350 words); the detail lives in the report
Flags the Supabase service_role key shipped to the browser (NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, used in client components)
Flags the .env with live keys that is still in git history, and says to rotate them
Flags the Stripe webhook that skips signature verification
Flags missing row-level security on the Supabase tables (or the public profiles policy)
Flags the admin page that is protected only on the client
Flags /api/groups/[id] returning any group (with members' emails/phones) without auth or membership check
Flags payment trust problems: client-sent price in checkout or Pro unlocked via localStorage
Flags the SSRF in /api/parse-receipt (server fetches a user-supplied URL)
Flags prompt injection or the AI tool fetching expenses for a model-chosen user_id
Flags the XSS via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in comments
Flags robots.txt 'Disallow: /' blocking search engines
Flags that there is no privacy policy
any_of: missing|no privacy|none|absent|doesn't exist|does not exist|not found|no page|no policy

checks.text: Flags the public 'receipts' storage bucket
Gives a verdict on backups and restore (#44), which generic security reviews skip
Gives a verdict on monitoring and alerting (#43)
Gives an opinion on trademarking the brand (#83)

evals.expected_output: VIBE_CHECK.md covering all 84 items; the planted FastAPI/React/nginx/compose problems found and ranked; a short chat reply.

Flags GET /api/orders/{id} returning any user's order (IDOR)
Flags the JWT secret that falls back to 'secret'
Flags the production database credentials hardcoded as a fallback in config.py
Flags MD5 password hashing
Flags path traversal in the file upload/download routes

Flags mass assignment letting users set their own role via PUT /users/me

Flags plaintext passwords written to logs

Flags Adminer / Postgres exposed on public ports with default credentials
